Bill.BriefDescription: Educating the public on requirements for securing vehicle loads on public highways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to educating the public on requirements forsecuring vehicle loads on public highways; adding a new section tochapter 43.59 RCW; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.59 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to the availability of amounts appropriated for thisspecific purpose, the Washington traffic safety commission shallimplement a public awareness campaign educating the public about therequirements for securing vehicle loads on public highways, andapplicable penalties for violating these requirements, under RCW46.61.655. As part of the campaign, the commission shall administer agrant program providing funding to the state and local governments topost signs along roadways visible to drivers indicating therequirements under RCW 46.61.655. If feasible, and under conditionssafe to the driving public, the signs should also indicate theapplicable penalties for violating RCW 46.61.655. At a minimum, thesigns must read: "State Law: Vehicles must secure all loads."

The sum of two hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the bienniumending June 30, 2009, from the motor vehicle fund to the Washingtontraffic safety commission for the purposes of this act.
